sentences.text: I could not find a document in force that states the interest rate for two-wheeler loans.
The bank’s retail loan policy says vehicle loans may be sanctioned for purchase of new two-wheelers, but it does not state an interest rate.
The current UCB business conduct directions list “Two Wheeler” under the rate-of-interest table, but the evidence provided does not include the actual rate value.
The prior KFS table that contained interest-rate fields was superseded and is no longer in force as of 2026-11-23.

missing.searched: Searched the in-force retail loan policy, UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions table for vehicle loans, and the withdrawn KFS interest-rate table; none provided the actual rate.
